kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارتعفن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفْنَ (irtaʕafna) /ir.ta.ʕaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفْنَ (urtuʕifna) /ur.tu.ʕif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اِرْتَعِفْنَ (irtaʕifna) /ir.ta.ʕif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
